Protected industrial action may affect waste collections in Hume. Put your bin out as usual on your scheduled collection day. If your bin is not collected, please leave it out for a catch-up collection.

Agendas, Minutes and Meeting Recordings

The agenda will be available at 3pm the Thursday prior to the meeting. Meeting minutes are available from 3pm on the Thursday following the meeting.  If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours.

You can request a hard copy of the agenda documents by contacting us.

Audio and video recordings of each meeting can be accessed below and be available within 48 hours of the meeting. If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours. 

You can also subscribe to Hume City Council Sound Cloud to listen to meeting recordings. 

Read the Hume City Council Meeting Public Participation Policy(PDF, 625KB)  and the Governance Rules(PDF, 712KB) of Hume City Council made in accordance with section 60 of the Local Government Act 2020.

Agendas, Minutes and Meeting Recordings

The agenda will be available at 3pm the Thursday prior to the meeting. Meeting minutes are available from 3pm on the Thursday following the meeting.  If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours.

You can request a hard copy of the agenda documents by contacting us.

Audio and video recordings of each meeting can be accessed below and be available within 48 hours of the meeting. If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours. 

You can also subscribe to Hume City Council Sound Cloud to listen to meeting recordings. 

Read the Hume City Council Meeting Public Participation Policy(PDF, 625KB)  and the Governance Rules(PDF, 712KB) of Hume City Council made in accordance with section 60 of the Local Government Act 2020.

Agendas, Minutes and Meeting Recordings

The agenda will be available at 3pm the Thursday prior to the meeting. Meeting minutes are available from 3pm on the Thursday following the meeting.  If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours.

You can request a hard copy of the agenda documents by contacting us.

Audio and video recordings of each meeting can be accessed below and be available within 48 hours of the meeting. If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours. 

You can also subscribe to Hume City Council Sound Cloud to listen to meeting recordings. 

Read the Hume City Council Meeting Public Participation Policy(PDF, 625KB)  and the Governance Rules(PDF, 712KB) of Hume City Council made in accordance with section 60 of the Local Government Act 2020.

Agendas, Minutes and Meeting Recordings

The agenda will be available at 3pm the Thursday prior to the meeting. Meeting minutes are available from 3pm on the Thursday following the meeting.  If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours.

You can request a hard copy of the agenda documents by contacting us.

Audio and video recordings of each meeting can be accessed below and be available within 48 hours of the meeting. If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours. 

You can also subscribe to Hume City Council Sound Cloud to listen to meeting recordings. 

Read the Hume City Council Meeting Public Participation Policy(PDF, 625KB)  and the Governance Rules(PDF, 712KB) of Hume City Council made in accordance with section 60 of the Local Government Act 2020.

Agendas, Minutes and Meeting Recordings

The agenda will be available at 3pm the Thursday prior to the meeting. Meeting minutes are available from 3pm on the Thursday following the meeting.  If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours.

You can request a hard copy of the agenda documents by contacting us.

Audio and video recordings of each meeting can be accessed below and be available within 48 hours of the meeting. If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours. 

You can also subscribe to Hume City Council Sound Cloud to listen to meeting recordings. 

Read the Hume City Council Meeting Public Participation Policy(PDF, 625KB)  and the Governance Rules(PDF, 712KB) of Hume City Council made in accordance with section 60 of the Local Government Act 2020.

Waste collection disruptions due to protected industrial action

Protected industrial action may affect waste collections in Hume. Put your bin out as usual on your scheduled collection day. If your bin is not collected, please leave it out for a catch-up collection.

Agendas, Minutes and Meeting Recordings

The agenda will be available at 3pm the Thursday prior to the meeting. Meeting minutes are available from 3pm on the Thursday following the meeting.  If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours.

You can request a hard copy of the agenda documents by contacting us.

Audio and video recordings of each meeting can be accessed below and be available within 48 hours of the meeting. If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours. 

You can also subscribe to Hume City Council Sound Cloud to listen to meeting recordings. 

Read the Hume City Council Meeting Public Participation Policy(PDF, 625KB)  and the Governance Rules(PDF, 712KB) of Hume City Council made in accordance with section 60 of the Local Government Act 2020.

Agendas, Minutes and Meeting Recordings

The agenda will be available at 3pm the Thursday prior to the meeting. Meeting minutes are available from 3pm on the Thursday following the meeting.  If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours.

You can request a hard copy of the agenda documents by contacting us.

Audio and video recordings of each meeting can be accessed below and be available within 48 hours of the meeting. If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours. 

You can also subscribe to Hume City Council Sound Cloud to listen to meeting recordings. 

Read the Hume City Council Meeting Public Participation Policy(PDF, 625KB)  and the Governance Rules(PDF, 712KB) of Hume City Council made in accordance with section 60 of the Local Government Act 2020.

Agendas, Minutes and Meeting Recordings

The agenda will be available at 3pm the Thursday prior to the meeting. Meeting minutes are available from 3pm on the Thursday following the meeting.  If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours.

You can request a hard copy of the agenda documents by contacting us.

Audio and video recordings of each meeting can be accessed below and be available within 48 hours of the meeting. If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours. 

You can also subscribe to Hume City Council Sound Cloud to listen to meeting recordings. 

Read the Hume City Council Meeting Public Participation Policy(PDF, 625KB)  and the Governance Rules(PDF, 712KB) of Hume City Council made in accordance with section 60 of the Local Government Act 2020.

Waste collection disruptions due to protected industrial action

Protected industrial action may affect waste collections in Hume. Put your bin out as usual on your scheduled collection day. If your bin is not collected, please leave it out for a catch-up collection.

For more information on affected services and collection schedules, visit Waste Updates in Hume

Agendas, Minutes and Meeting Recordings

The agenda will be available at 3pm the Thursday prior to the meeting. Meeting minutes are available from 3pm on the Thursday following the meeting.  If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours.

You can request a hard copy of the agenda documents by contacting us.

Audio and video recordings of each meeting can be accessed below and be available within 48 hours of the meeting. If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours. 

You can also subscribe to Hume City Council Sound Cloud to listen to meeting recordings. 

Read the Hume City Council Meeting Public Participation Policy(PDF, 625KB)  and the Governance Rules(PDF, 712KB) of Hume City Council made in accordance with section 60 of the Local Government Act 2020.

You can request a hard copy of the agenda documents by contacting us.

Audio and video recordings of each meeting can be accessed below and be available within 48 hours of the meeting. If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours. 

You can also subscribe to Hume City Council Sound Cloud to listen to meeting recordings.

Agendas, Minutes and Meeting Recordings

The agenda will be available at 3pm the Thursday prior to the meeting. Meeting minutes are available from 3pm on the Thursday following the meeting.  If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours.

You can request a hard copy of the agenda documents by contacting us.

Audio and video recordings of each meeting can be accessed below and be available within 48 hours of the meeting. If the Council meeting was held after a public holiday, this information may be delayed by 24 hours. 

You can also subscribe to Hume City Council Sound Cloud to listen to meeting recordings. 

Read the Hume City Council Meeting Public Participation Policy(PDF, 625KB)  and the Governance Rules(PDF, 712KB) of Hume City Council made in accordance with section 60 of the Local Government Act 2020.
